THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No :H/TNG/RDA/2015/753.Land Ministry Ref. No. : 4-3/6/2014/HW/366.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquirethe following lands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot No. 864 - 869 (Lots 06) allotments in total extent ofabout 0.0984 Hectare, of land in final Village Plan Plan No. 290,Supplement No. 32, Sheet No. 25 and dated 26.01.2016prepared by the Sinior - Superintendent of Survey ofHambanthota Distric on behalf of Survey General, situatedin the Grama Niladhari Division of Thenagama North in thevillage of Nalagama in Minor Division of GiruwapaththuwaSouth, Divisional Secretary’s Division of Tangalle inHambanthota District in the Southern Province.

on the from 05.07.2016 at 10.00 and are hereby requested tonotify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27.06.2016the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of theirclaims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands,the amount of compensation and the details of the computationof such amount.
